title: Step 66-G public Archive and Stop-Sale Storefront views
description: HIGH-risk Step 66-G. Define the smallest Storefront route boundary /archive and /stop-sale and render only the public read semantics made canonical in Step 66-B. Archive exposes historical published product identity without price, inventory, availability or archive reason. Stop-sale consumes only the dedicated public endpoint and must not infer stop-sale from inventory. Both views are noindex,follow and are excluded from sitemap. Final exact-artifact Project Owner Human Gate is mandatory.

dependencies.evidence: PR #348 merged; exact-SHA Canonical CI #1688, Phase A #1187, Storefront Quality #747 and CodeQL #824 SUCCESS; terminal Lock release comment 6107217258.
PR #341 established typed GET /catalog/archive and GET /catalog/stop-sale public contracts.

evidence.route_authority: Stage 66-G explicitly defines /archive and /stop-sale as the smallest Storefront route boundary for the already-canonical public read contracts.
evidence.archive_authority: GET /catalog/archive: historically published archived products only; minimal ArchivedProductCard; no archive_reason, price, availability, inventory, variants or admin state.
evidence.stop_sale_authority: GET /catalog/stop-sale: currently published products whose effective sales authority is false; inventory-only out-of-stock does not qualify; no internal stop reason/scope exposed.
evidence.seo: Both state-list pages are noindex,follow and intentionally excluded from sitemap.

acceptance_criteria.description: Archive/stop-sale response types derive only from generated OpenAPI ApiSuccessData and cursor inputs remain opaque, bounded and route-scoped.
Archive renders only historical identity/category/brand/archived timestamp from ArchivedProductCard; it never displays or invents price, availability, stock, archive reason, variants or admin state.
Stop-sale uses only GET /catalog/stop-sale authority, labels sales as stopped, and does not infer the state from in_stock or disclose internal reason/scope.
Both pages have Persian RTL semantic one-H1 accessible ready/empty/error/pagination states and minimum touch/focus behavior.
Both pages emit robots noindex,follow and are not added to sitemap.xml.
Inherited shell/static/browser quality route inventories include /archive and /stop-sale without weakening prior route checks.

HIGH-risk canonical closure requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront Quality, CodeQL/Security, deterministic Review PASS, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, Project Owner Human Gate approval, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Step 66-G is HIGH risk. Exact-artifact Project Owner Human approval is mandatory after technical/security/review/Lock evidence is complete.
